detections.description: Two individuals engage in close physical combat; one appears to strike or grapple the other in a dimly lit alleyway.

A large group of individuals (≥6) is gathered in a chaotic, aggressive formation; some hold objects resembling weapons, and collective motion suggests violent unrest rather than a static confrontation.

A person is on the ground while multiple others surround and appear to assault them; one individual is crouched over the prone figure in a manner consistent with striking or subduing a helpless victim.
A large group of individuals converges violently in a confined space; some are armed, others are being subdued or attacked, indicating collective violent unrest.
Multiple armed individuals aim and fire handguns; muzzle flash and smoke are visible in frames f13–f15, confirming active gunfire.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical combat, with one person on top of the other in a struggle; visible grappling and forceful movement suggest mutual physical combat.
A person is being physically subdued or attacked by another individual in a dim, smoky room; the victim appears prone and helpless while the attacker looms over them.

A bright muzzle flash is visible in near-total darkness, consistent with a firearm discharge; the intense, directional light burst with smoke/propellant residue confirms a shot being fired.; A bright muzzle flash is visible in darkness, consistent with a firearm discharge; silhouetted figures are present nearby, suggesting an active shooting event.
A sudden, intense white flash erupts from a television set or appliance, accompanied by smoke/dust, indicating a violent internal explosion or electrical detonation.
A sudden, intense flash of white light erupts from the television set, accompanied by visible smoke and debris, consistent with an electrical explosion or implosion.
A second muzzle flash occurs in near-total darkness, with a silhouette of a weapon and hand visible; consistent with another gunshot.
A second bright flash and smoke plume appear near the ceiling/light fixture, suggesting a secondary electrical failure or explosion following the first event.

A person in striped clothing is seen lying on the ground while another individual repeatedly strikes or presses down on them in a dark indoor setting, consistent with physical abuse of a helpless victim.

A person in light-colored clothing appears to be restraining or assaulting a prone, dark-furred figure (possibly an animal or person) on the ground in a dimly lit indoor setting; hands are positioned over the figure’s head/upper body across frames f0–f2, with motion suggesting forceful contact.

A group of silhouetted individuals gathers aggressively around a prone figure on a street at night; their postures and clustering suggest violent unrest or collective assault, not a passive crowd.; A large group of silhouetted individuals gathers and moves agitatedly on a street at night near a prone figure lying on the pavement; their postures and clustering suggest collective unrest or violent confrontation, not a passive crowd.
